findings: 16/16 mixing ingredients confirmed against the supplied in-game Gas-Mart screenshot and current Schedule1 Tools ingredient list.
35/35 effect names are represented in Helper; Schedule1 Tools open-source Mixer currently exports 34 effect codes, while Helper keeps Lethal separately.
114 standard transformation rules are documented by Schedule1 Tools.
Schedule1 Tools /mixes is client-rendered and currently exposes 0 mix records to the crawler, so the full 77-record catalog cannot be safely bulk-extracted from that page in this environment.
Individual Schedule1 Tools mixer pages can be verified and are treated as the authority for stored community mix outputs.
Some community mix outputs differ from the older open-source Mixer snapshot; Helper therefore records live-page verification separately from derived standard calculations.
Seeded Mixing is save-specific. The tool can import save JSON and infer recorded rules, but a seed value alone does not reconstruct the already-recorded per-save interaction table.
asset_policy: Never invent an exact icon. Use a named public asset only when its source identifies the effect/item; otherwise use the verified in-game color/name treatment.

seeded_mixing.reason: The public research source documents per-save rule generation and persistence; previously triggered rules must be read from the actual save or observed in-game.
